name: King Legacy
tagline: Working King Legacy codes for free gems, stat resets and Beli boosts.
description: King Legacy is a Roblox One Piece-inspired adventure where players hunt Devil Fruits, master Haki and battle bosses across the seas. New codes drop after major updates, follower milestones, and developer livestreams. Most codes grant gems, stat resets or temporary XP and Beli boosts. Every code on this page has been cross-checked against the latest Pro Game Guides update list.
longDescription:
King Legacy is a Roblox One Piece-inspired adventure built by Venture Studios (formerly Sea King Games). Launched in 2020, it sits in the same broad genre as Blox Fruits — sail between islands, hunt Devil Fruits, train Haki, fight world bosses — but with a more deliberate progression curve and a distinct combat system that leans more heavily on stat customisation than Blox Fruits' fruit-centric design.

The two resources that bottleneck most King Legacy accounts are **Gems** (the premium currency, used for fruit rerolls and cosmetic colour changes) and **Stat Reset tokens** (which let you redistribute your Melee, Defense, Sword, Gun, and Devil Fruit points). Free Gems are exceptionally rare outside of milestone events, which makes the Gem-paying codes here disproportionately valuable. Stat Reset codes — `2MFAV`, `FREESTATSRESET`, `Sub2UncleKizaru` — are the second-highest priority because they let you reroll a build commit without paying the in-game Beli cost.

King Legacy's code system has one unusual property compared to most active Roblox games: the developer team keeps a long tail of older codes redeemable indefinitely. `Peodiz`, `RainbowDragon`, `SKGames`, and `DinoxLive` all date back to 2025 and remain redeemable as of mid-2026. This means a brand-new King Legacy account can pull down a substantial backlog of free Cash and XP boosts on day one — a deliberate developer choice that contrasts sharply with the two-week soft expiry common to other Roblox grinders.
videoTitle: How to redeem codes in King Legacy
whatCodesDo:
King Legacy codes drop one of five reward types, each with a very different practical value. **Gems** are the rarest and most valuable: each Gem-paying code typically gives 10 to 100 Gems, which is the only free path to fruit rerolls and cosmetic colour changes — every other source requires Robux. Bank Gem code rewards until you have a specific reroll target.

**Stat Reset** codes refund all your stat points, letting you redistribute your Melee, Defense, Sword, Gun, and Devil Fruit allocation without paying the in-game Beli cost. The active codes `2MFAV`, `FREESTATSRESET`, and `Sub2UncleKizaru` each pay out a one-time reset; save them for a major build commit (new fruit, new sword class) rather than burning them early.

**Cash / Beli** rewards (e.g. `Peodiz` and `DinoxLive` at 100,000 Cash each) cover an early-game ship purchase or a Haki training session. Useful for fresh accounts but easily out-grindable. **XP boosts** (`WELCOMETOKINGLEGACY`, `<3LEEPUNGG` at 30 minutes of 2x XP) are best used during awakening grinds or Haki training sessions. The multiplier does not stack, but the durations do — chain code XP back-to-back for a continuous one-hour boost.

**Special rewards** like `RainbowDragon`'s 100 Gems for legacy Rainbow Dragon owners or `FIXEDBUG1003`'s 3 Gold Keys are situational; check each code's notes column for the exact eligibility rules.
whereToFindMore: New King Legacy codes are announced first on the official [@KingLegacyRBLX Twitter / X account](https://twitter.com/KingLegacyRBLX) and on the [Venture Studios Discord server](https://discord.gg/kinglegacy). Both go live within minutes of the in-game code switch being flipped. Beyond the official channels, partnered creators Daigrock, UncleKizaru, and DinoxLive each have one or more legacy codes still redeemable today. The King Legacy Fandom wiki maintains a community-edited code list, but it lags the Twitter account by 30 to 60 minutes and occasionally lists expired codes as active. We refresh this page within 24 hours of any new code announcement; bookmark the [latest codes view](/king-legacy/latest) for the cleanest list.
releaseCadence: King Legacy drops codes on a slower cadence than most active Roblox grinders, but the tradeoff is that older codes stay alive longer. **Major updates** ship every six to ten weeks and usually include a single launch code (Update 10 brought `Update10Release`; the rumoured Update 11 will likely follow the same pattern). **Milestone events** — favourite counts, like counts, anniversary celebrations — drop one to two single-reward codes each, almost always a Stat Reset or a Gems payout. **Partnered creator codes** (`Peodiz`, `DinoxLive`, `SKGames`) are added sporadically and tend to stay perma-redeemable; the development team rarely retires creator codes. **Bug-fix compensation codes** (`FIXEDBUG1003`, `FIXEDDROPBOOST`) appear after any unscheduled fix that affected normal gameplay, and these have a tight 2-to-4-week window.
expiredCodesContext: King Legacy's expired pool is smaller than most active Roblox grinders because the developer keeps creator and milestone codes redeemable for extended periods. The codes archived below mostly fall into two buckets: bug-fix compensation codes with a tight 2-to-4-week window (`FIXEDBUG1003`, `FIXEDDROPBOOST`, `FreePterSpin`), and update-launch codes that were retired with the next patch (`Update10Release`). We keep the archive live so returning players can quickly confirm a code they saw in a YouTube thumbnail is genuinely dead, and so the dates document Venture Studios' release cadence.

redeemSteps.title: Launch King Legacy on Roblox
redeemSteps.detail: Open Roblox on your platform of choice — PC, mobile, Xbox, or web — and start any King Legacy session. You can be on any island in any sea; codes can be redeemed from anywhere as long as you are in the live game. The codes flow works in private servers too, but stat-reset codes redeemed there still apply to your main account.

redeemSteps.title: Open the in-game menu (M on PC, menu button on mobile)
redeemSteps.detail: Press M on PC to bring up the main menu, or tap the menu button (three lines, usually at the top of the mobile UI) on phones and tablets. On Xbox the menu opens via the View button. You should see a panel slide in with several tabs — Inventory, Settings, Shop, Stats, and so on.

redeemSteps.title: Tap the Twitter / X icon inside the menu
redeemSteps.detail: Look for the small blue bird icon among the top row of menu icons — it sits between the Stats and Settings tabs. Tapping it opens a single-line code redemption text box and a Redeem button. Older YouTube tutorials still point at the Shop panel for codes; that location was moved to the Twitter icon in an early 2026 UI refresh.

redeemSteps.title: Paste the code character-for-character
redeemSteps.detail: Copy a code from this page using the Copy button next to it, then paste it into the in-game text box. King Legacy codes are case-sensitive and often include special characters and numbers (e.g. `<3LEEPUNGG`, `FIXEDBUG1003`) that are easy to mistype. Always copy-paste rather than retyping. The text box does not auto-correct.

redeemSteps.title: Press Redeem and confirm
redeemSteps.detail: Tap the green Redeem button below the text box. A confirmation toast appears on success. If the code is rejected, the most common cause is mistyped capitalisation or a special character (the `<3` in `<3LEEPUNGG` is two characters, not one). Stat resets and Gems arrive instantly; XP boost timers begin counting down on your character.

troubleshooting.cause: The code has expired, or you mistyped a special character (the `<3` in `<3LEEPUNGG` trips up most players).
troubleshooting.fix: Cross-check against our [Expired Codes archive](/king-legacy/expired). If it is not there, copy-paste it directly from our Active table — every entry is verified within 24 hours.

troubleshooting.symptom: Red error: 'You already used this code'
troubleshooting.cause: Each King Legacy code is one-time per Roblox account. You cannot redeem the same code twice on the same account.
troubleshooting.fix: Move on to the next code. If you genuinely never redeemed it on this account, the in-game logic is rarely wrong; double-check whether you redeemed it on a different display name on the same account.

troubleshooting.symptom: Code worked but the stat reset did not happen
troubleshooting.cause: Stat resets are confirmed in the Stats tab, not via an in-game toast. Some players miss the silent confirmation.
troubleshooting.fix: Open the menu → Stats tab. Your points should now all be redistributable. If the panel still shows your old allocation, rejoin the server once.

troubleshooting.symptom: Cannot see the Twitter / X icon at all
troubleshooting.cause: Older YouTube tutorials still point at the Shop panel for codes — but the redeem flow moved to the Twitter icon in early 2026.
troubleshooting.fix: Press M (PC) or tap the menu button (mobile) and look for the blue Twitter / X bird icon in the top row of menu tabs.

troubleshooting.cause: `SKGames` requires you to be a member of the official Sea King Games Roblox group. Without group membership the code is silently rejected.
troubleshooting.fix: Join the [Sea King Games Roblox group](https://www.roblox.com/groups/seakings) first, then return to the game and retry the code.

faq.question: How often do King Legacy codes release?
faq.answer: Codes drop in three windows: major updates (every six to ten weeks, usually one launch code), milestone events (favourite / like counts, one to two codes each), and partnered-creator drops. Bug-fix compensation codes appear sporadically after unscheduled hotfixes. Older creator codes tend to stay perma-redeemable, which is unusual compared to other Roblox grinders.

faq.question: Why is my King Legacy code not working?
faq.answer: The three common causes are case-sensitivity (`<3LEEPUNGG` is not `<3leepungg`), expiry (cross-check against our Expired Codes page), and special characters (the `<3` in some codes is two characters, not one). If you copy-pasted directly from our Active list and it still fails, it has almost certainly just expired — tell us and we will move it within an hour.

faq.question: Can I redeem the same code twice on different accounts?
faq.answer: Yes. Each Roblox account can redeem a given King Legacy code once. A code already used on your main can still be redeemed on an alt, though Gems and Stat Reset rewards do not transfer between accounts.

faq.question: Why does the SKGames code keep failing for me?
faq.answer: `SKGames` is a group-membership-gated code — you have to join the official Sea King Games Roblox group before it will pay out. The code is silently rejected if you are not a group member. Join the group, return to the game, and the code will redeem normally.

faq.question: What is the most valuable King Legacy code I can redeem right now?
faq.answer: For most accounts the answer is `FREESTATSRESET` followed by `2MFAV` and `Sub2UncleKizaru` — three free stat refunds in a row let you reroll your entire build for nothing. After those, the legacy Cash codes `Peodiz` and `DinoxLive` together pay 200,000 Cash, enough for an early-game ship purchase or a Haki training session.

faq.question: Do King Legacy codes work on mobile, Xbox, and PC equally?
faq.answer: Yes. The redemption logic runs on the Roblox server, not the client, so codes work identically on every platform that supports Roblox. Only the position of the menu button on screen differs slightly — PC uses the M key shortcut while mobile and Xbox use on-screen menu buttons.

faq.question: Are there any 'secret' King Legacy codes not on this list?
faq.answer: No. Every working King Legacy code is announced through the official Twitter / X account, the Discord server, or a partnered creator stream. If a YouTube thumbnail promises a 'secret' code, it is almost always either a known code rebranded or a clickbait link to a fake redemption site. Stick to the codes on this page or the official channels.

faq.question: Can I get banned for using King Legacy codes?
faq.answer: No. Codes are an official feature built directly into the menu by Venture Studios. The only way you can get banned around code use is by sharing or selling Roblox account credentials, which violates the Roblox Terms of Service regardless of whether codes are involved.
